mapper.select: SELECT lr.*, (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name) AS employee_name FROM leave_requests lr LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id WHERE lr.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY lr.id DESC
SELECT lr.*, (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name) AS employee_name FROM leave_requests lr LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id WHERE lr.id = #{id} AND lr.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_requests SET status = #{status}, approver_comment = #{approverComment}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
